cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; an indoor surf-wave practice pool with turquoise water — she takes a cheerful break from balancing practice; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing close to a high shelf or line; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a bright glass-roofed intercity tram moving through a coastal city — she balances a small paper bag of freshly roasted chestnuts on her lap; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — kneeling on the ground; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds a small bouquet at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a bright bathroom with a mirror — carries a small storage box against her waist
